t: Habara ulehachem mayim muttar beyom tob
s: Habara ulehachem mayim muttar beyom tob ubo z' seipim: kebar nitbaer besimman ttz"h, demittok shehuttera habara letzorek akila — huttera apillu shello letzorek akila, ubilbad sheyyehe bah tzorek yom tob, lepikak muttar laasot medura lehitchammem kenegdah beyom tob. Veken muttar lehachem meat mayim lirchotz bahem panayv yadayv veraglayv beyom tob. Abal asur lehachem mayim rabbim kede lirchotz bahem kol gupo. Vezeh haissur yesh omerim sheeno ella middibrehem, lepi shemmin hattora mittok shehutteru habara ubishshul letzorek akila ushetiyya — hutteru letzorek rechitzat yom tob, lepikak ap middibrehem muttar lirchotz kol gupo bemayim shehuchammu meereb yom tob, veen chosheshin im nattir lo lirchotz bechammin beyom tob shemma yachem mayim beyom tob, kevan sheen issur lehachem mayim beyom tob ella middibre soperim — en gozerin gezera ligzera. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesherochetz chutz lammerchatz, abal betok hammerchatz asur lirchotz bechammin apillu panayv yadayv veraglayv bilbad, vk"z bechammin shehuchammu meereb yom tob, abal kol gupo bebat achat asur apillu lehishtattep bechammin shehuchammu meereb yom tob. Veken asur lirchotz kol gupo apillu chutz lammerchatz bechammin shehuchammu beyom tob, apillu huchammu letzorek shetiyya, vaapillu eno rochetz kol gupo bebat achat ella rochatzo eber eber asur. Abal tinoq shedderek lerochotzo bekol yom — muttar lirchotz kol gupo bebat achat apillu bechammin shehuchammu beyom tob letzorek shetiyya, dekevan shehu tzorko shel tinoq — lo gazeru alayv. Abal asur lehachem beyom tob bishbil rechitzato bilbad kemo sheasur lehachem bishbil rechitzat kol gupo shel haggadol, ella im ken hu mechammem letzorek shetiyya o letzorek hadachat kele "okel nepesh", deaz muttar lo lehosip mayim baqqedera bishbil rechitzat haqqatan. Vehu sheyyosip qodem sheyyitten haqqedera etzel haesh, kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"g, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh. Veakshav bizman hazzeh sheap bechol peamim sheen rochatzim et hattinoq shenayim o shelosha yamim — ap beyom tob asur lirchotz kol gupo bechammin shehuchammu beyom tob, apillu rochatzo eber eber. Abal yesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim demin hattora asur lehachem mayim rabbim bishbil rechitzat kol haggup (ella im ken hu mechammem kol hammayim beyachad bikli echad im hammayim sherochetz bahem panayv yadayv veraglayv veal derek shennitbaer besimman tq"g), lepi sherchitzat kol haggup enah tzorek kol nepesh ella limunnagim umepunnaqim bilbad, velo hittira hattora apillu hammelaka shelletzorek akila ella im ken yesh bah tzorek kol nepesh, abal im en bah tzorek ella limunnagim asur laasotah beyom tob kemo sheyyitbaer. Vekevan sheyyesh bezeh issur shel tora — yesh leesor lirchotz kol gupo beyom tob apillu chutz lammerchatz, vaapillu bechammin shehuchammu meereb yom tob, gezera shemma yachem mayim beyom tob bishbil rechitzat kol gupo veyaaseh issur min hattora. Ulepi dibrehem ap tinoq shedderek lerochotzo bekol yom asur lerochotzo apillu bechammin shehuchammu meereb yom tob kemo beshabbat, ukemo shennitbaer besimman shl"a, gezera shemma yachem beyom tob bishbilo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Lirchotz kol gupo bebat achat, abal lirchotz kol gupo eber eber bechammim shehuchammu meereb yom tob — muttar apillu legadol, shekkol eber veeber shehu rochetz hu rochetz behetter, deen ligzor shemma yachem mayim beyom tob, shehare muttar lehachem mayim beyom tob bishbil rechitzat eber echad, veen issur ella lehachem bishbil rechitzat kol haggup, sheen tzarik ella limunnagim. (Abal kol gupo bebat achat asur apillu lehishtattep bechammin, apillu huchammu meereb yom tob). Veap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara harishona bekol zeh, mikkol maqom kebar nahagu bimdinot ellu lehachamir kisbara haacharona. Veen leshannot hamminhag.

Yesh mi sheomer sheen hetter laasot medura lehitchammem kenegdah beyom tob ella beshaa shehaqqor gadol kol kak ad sherob bene adam tzerikim lehitchammem keneged hammedura, abal im en haqqor gadol kol kak beinyan sheen tzarik limdura raq mi shehu istenis (perush ish metzunnan) o meunnag — en laasot medura velo lehachem tannure batte hachorep raq al yede nokri, kevan shemmelaka zo enah tzerika lekol nepesh. Abal en hamminhag kidbarayv. Veap lidbarayv, im haqqor gadol kol kak ad shehammaakalim hashshemenim shehu rotzeh leekol yihyu niqrashim mechamat haqqor, ap al pi sheen haqqor gadol kol kak sheyyihyu rob bene adam tzerikim lehitchammem — muttar lo lehachem bet hachorep bishbil hammaakalim, shehare hu tzorek "okel nepesh".

Muttar lehanniach basar al gabbe gechalim litzloto ap al pi shehashshamnunit hannotep mehabbasar mekabbeh et haggechalim, vekibbuy zeh en bo tzorek "okel nepesh" mammash, shehare epshar litzloto beshappud, mikkol maqom, kevan sheyyesh bo qetzat tzorek "okel nepesh", shehare hu chapetz umitavveh leekol beinyan zeh — hittiru lo chakamim, kevan sheen kan kibbuy gamur, shehare sopo mabir.

Veken muttar leashshen perot, dehaynu shemmepazzer mine besamim al gabbe gechalim tachat happerot kede sheyyiqletu taam habbosem veyihyu yoter tobim laakila. Veap al pi shehaggechalim nikbim qetzat bitchillat hannachat habbesamim alehem, vekibbuy zeh en bo tzorek "okel nepesh" mammash, shehare happerot reuyin laakila belo ishshun, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu chapetz leekol kak — hittiru lo chakamim, kevan sheen kan kibbuy gamur, shehare sopo mabir.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmepazzer et habbesamim al gabbe gechalim shehubaru kebar letzorek "okel nepesh" o letzorek shear debarim shemmuttar lehabir bishbilam beyom tob, abal asur lehabir etzim kede lepazzer mine besamim tachat happerot al gabbe gachaltan, lepi shehanaa zo shel taam habbesamim enah tzerika lekol nepesh ella lehammeunnagim umepunnaqim bilbad, velo hittira hattora laasot shum melaka mimmelakot "okel nepesh" ella ledabar shehu tzarik lekol nepesh, shenneemar "ak asher yeakel lekol nepesh vego'".

Vaapillu al gabbe gechalim shehubaru kebar en lepazzer mine besamim kede legammer et habbayit o et hakkelim, dekevan sheen kan tzorek akila kelal — lo hittiru apillu habara muetet, shehabbesamim mitbaarim al haggechalim. Veap al pi shehahabara huttera apillu shello letzorek akila, mikkol maqom lo huttera ella im ken yesh bah tzorek yom tob vetzorek zeh hu shaveh lekol nepesh, kemo shennitbaer.

Vaapillu leashshen perot en hetter ella keshemmitkavven kede sheyyiqletu happerot taam habbosem veyihyu yoter tobim laakila, abal asur leashshen perot kede sheyyiqletu reach habbosem ubaakilato otam yehaneh merecham hattob, lepi sheasur leholid reach beyom tob bedabar shello haya bo reach, shehammolid dabar chadash qarob hu leoseh melaka chadasha. Veap al pi shekkol hammelakot hutteru letzorek akila, mikkol maqom holadat reach zeh en bo tzorek "okel nepesh" kol kak veeno shaveh lakkol. Velo hittiru leashshen ella kesheeno mitkavven sheyyiqletu happerot reach habbosem ella taam habbosem veyihyu yoter tobim laakila. Veap al pi shemmimmela nolad bahen reach chadash, mikkol maqom, kevan (shehaiqqar) shehu eno mitkavven leholid — lo gazeru alayv. Ulepikak muttar lehanniach mine besamim al habbeged im eno mitkavven leholid reach babbeged, abal im hu mitkavven lekak asur. Veim kebar haya munnach min bosem zeh al beged zeh beinyan shekkebar niknas reach habbosem babbeged — muttar lehanniach alayv beyom tob od mimmin bosem zeh kede lehosip reach bosem zeh babbeged, abal asur lehanniach alayv min bosem acher, shehare hu molid reach chadash babbeged beyom tob. Veshello kaddin osin bemiqtzat meqomot shennotenin shemen shemmeriach (sheqqorin sheppigenar"d) letok hammayim shehakkohanim notelin mehem layyadayim laalot laddukan, shehare hem mitkavvenim leholid reach chadash al yede hakkohanim. Veap al pi sheshshopekin hashshemen letok hammayim meereb yom tob, mikkol maqom beyom tob keshehakkohanim notelin yedehen hen molidin reach chadash bidehem, vehen nehenim mereach zeh, vehu noach lahem umitkavvenim lekak, al ken yesh limnoa millaasot ken.
